````text
# #4936: Patch: `permanents_on_field` meets a card lying on a unit zone after its side's backrow
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Ticketed can stack itself onto an enemy Unit, where it lies on that unit zone: not a Unit, but still a permanent. The rules say a sweep of every permanent meets such a card after its side's backrow zones. One list in the engine still puts it up among the Units instead. That list feeds the plague-placement options, random plague placements, random exiles of the field, and the Radiant-field pool, so on such a board the same seed can offer or hit a different card than the rules' order says. After the fix, every every-permanent list agrees on the pinned order.

## Why

spec/03-zones.md (Stack bullet) pins the order, citing R4665000: a sweep of the backrow, of the Field Spells, or of every permanent meets a lying card after that side's backrow zones. Patch #4760 fixed the sibling lists to match: `enemy_permanents` (crates/engine/src/query.rs), `backrow_of` (crates/engine/src/state_check.rs:120-127), `field_spells_doomed` (crates/engine/src/effects/datacenter.rs:142-145), and `is_adjacent_card` (crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1740-1742). It missed `permanents_on_field` (crates/engine/src/plague.rs:32-38), which walks `acting_on` (crates/engine/src/zones.rs), and that walk pushes every unit-zone top unfiltered, lying cards included. The helper for the pinned spot already exists (`lying_on_unit_zones_of`, crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1767). Consumers of the missed list: plague prompt options and random placements (crates/engine/src/effects/plague.rs:194), random field exiles (crates/engine/src/effects/move_.rs:133), the Radiant-field pool (crates/engine/src/effects/radiant.rs:114), and anomaly copies (crates/engine/src/effects/anomaly.rs:194). Only Ticketed creates lying cards today, so the blast radius is tiny but the divergence is observable through seeded picks.

## Proposal

In `permanents_on_field`, filter lying tops out of each side's `acting_on` pass and append `lying_on_unit_zones_of` after the backrow section, the exact pattern `enemy_permanents` and `backrow_of` already use, and update the doc comment to cite R4665000. Leave `acting_on` itself untouched: aura and field-text reads correctly include the lying top since its auras project. Add a scenario test in the Ticketed module plus one seeded-pick test.

## Where it lands

crates/engine/src/plague.rs (`permanents_on_field`; `reachable_permanents_on_field` inherits it). Tests in crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs, which already holds lying-card scenarios. No spec change: the spec already states the rule, the implementation catches up.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A card lying on a unit zone is met after its side's backrow tops in `permanents_on_field` / `reachable_permanents_on_field`, per side
- [ ] It is met exactly once (count unchanged: no drop, no double-count)
- [ ] Plague placement options list it after backrow cards; seeded random placements and exiles over such a board match the spec order
- [ ] Boards without lying cards produce byte-identical lists (no golden churn outside lying-card games)
- [ ] Engine and card test suites green

## Size and risks

S. Risk is low and bounded: only boards with a card lying on a unit zone (only Ticketed today) combined with these effects change outcome; both seats share the engine so there is no client skew.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45664175000)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Fix `permanents_on_field` (`crates/engine/src/plague.rs`) so a card lying on a unit zone (Ticketed) is met after its side's backrow tops, per side, exactly once — matching the order `spec/03-zones.md` (Stack bullet) and R4665000 already pin. The fix flows automatically into `reachable_permanents_on_field` and its consumers (plague prompts and random placements, random field exiles, the Radiant-field pool, anomaly copies). No spec change: the implementation catches up to the stated rule. Prove it with two scenario tests in the Ticketed module.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/plague.rs` | change | `permanents_on_field`: filter lying tops out of each side's `acting_on` pass, append `lying_on_unit_zones_of` per side; doc comment cites R4665000. Extend the `zones` import. |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs` | change | Two tests in `mod tests` → `mod base`, reusing `stacked`/`board` helpers. |

Do not touch: `crates/engine/src/zones.rs` (`acting_on` stays as is — aura and field-text reads rely on the lying top), `spec/` (rule already stated), `crates/engine/src/effects/*` (consumers inherit the fix), `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: `spec/03-zones.md` Stack bullet; ruling R4665000.

## Steps

1. Re-read `crates/engine/src/plague.rs:28-50`, `crates/engine/src/zones.rs:1765-1815` (`lying_on_unit_zones_of`, `acting_on`), and `crates/engine/src/query.rs:697-723` (`enemy_permanents`, the exact pattern to copy).
2. In `crates/engine/src/plague.rs`, extend the import to `use crate::zones::{StandingAt, acting_on, is_buried, lies_on_unit_zone, lying_on_unit_zones_of};` and rewrite the body of `permanents_on_field` so each side filters lying tops out of its `acting_on` pass and appends the lying cards after its backrow section:
```rust
pub fn permanents_on_field(state: &GameState, first: impl Into<Option<PlayerId>>) -> Vec<&CardInstance> {
    let first = first.into().unwrap_or(state.active);
    [first, opponent_of(first)]
        .into_iter()
        .flat_map(|player| {
            acting_on(state, player, StandingAt::ItsLane)
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|card| !lies_on_unit_zone(state, card))
                .chain(lying_on_unit_zones_of(state, player))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        })
        .collect()
}
```
A lying card is disjoint from standing/carried cards (it has no position), so count is unchanged: dropped from the Units pass, re-added once after the backrow. Leave `acting_on` and `reachable_permanents_on_field` untouched.
3. Update the doc comment on `permanents_on_field` to describe the per-side order (units lane 1 upward, carried Units, backrow lane 1 upward, then the cards lying on that side's unit zones) and cite R4665000, mirroring the wording on `enemy_permanents`.
4. In `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs`, `mod base`, copy the shape of `r4665000_enemy_permanents_lists_it_after_their_backrow` and add test 1 `r4665000_permanents_on_field_lists_a_lying_card_after_that_sides_backrow`: build `stacked(json!([]))` to get `[left, pawn, ticketed, _]`; assert `jackioh_engine::query::permanents_on_field(s.state(), P2)` ids equal `vec![left, pawn, ticketed]`, the same for `reachable_permanents_on_field`, and the same for first `P1` (P1 side empty, then P2's three). Length 3 in each case (exactly once).
5. Add test 2 `r4665000_a_seeded_draw_over_the_field_meets_the_spec_order` in the same module: rebuild the `stacked` board, take the `reachable_permanents_on_field(s.state(), P2)` id list, assert it equals `[left, pawn, ticketed]`, then draw with two identically-seeded rngs (`let mut rng = create_rng("ticketed-every-permanent", 0);`) over (a) that list and (b) the pre-fix order rebuilt live as `jackioh_engine::zones::acting_on(s.state(), P2, jackioh_engine::zones::StandingAt::ItsLane)` ids (analytically `[left, ticketed, pawn]`). Assert the two `rng.shuffle(&ids)[0]` picks differ, and pin the fixed pick with an exact `assert_eq!` on the shuffled vector. (`create_rng` is already in scope via `testkit::*`, as `scope_ids` shows; `Rng::shuffle` is `crates/engine/src/rng.rs:80`.)
6. Run the checks in Tests, then `git diff --stat` to confirm only the two files changed.

## Tests

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c009_ticketed.rs`, `mod base`: `r4665000_permanents_on_field_lists_a_lying_card_after_that_sides_backrow` asserts the full ordered id lists (`permanents_on_field` and `reachable_permanents_on_field`, first `P2` and first `P1`) equal `[left, pawn, ticketed]` with length 3. Pre-fix the order is `[left, ticketed, pawn]`, so it fails without the fix by construction.
- Same file: `r4665000_a_seeded_draw_over_the_field_meets_the_spec_order` asserts the same-seed shuffle pick over the fixed list differs from the pick over the legacy `acting_on` position, pinning the observable seeded divergence through the exact pool every consumer draws from.
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c009_ticketed`; `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --lib`; `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] A lying card sorts after its side's backrow tops in `permanents_on_field` / `reachable_permanents_on_field`, per side, both `first` values.
- [ ] It appears exactly once (list length unchanged vs pre-fix on the same board).
- [ ] Plague option order and seeded draws follow the spec order (both new tests green; they fail on the pre-fix order by construction).
- [ ] No-lying-card boards produce identical lists (filter is a no-op plus an empty append; existing suites green, no golden churn).
- [ ] Only the two files above changed; `fmt`, both `clippy` runs, both test runs, and `spec check` pass.

## Risks

- Determinism: the new list is still built by lane-order walks plus one deterministic append, so same `(seed, cursor)` draws stay reproducible; only boards with a lying card change outcome, and both seats share the engine so there is no client skew.
- Hidden information: the list feeds prompt options; ordering a visible permanent differently reveals nothing new (same set, same membership).
- `acting_on` callers (auras, field text) are unaffected because `acting_on` itself is not modified.

## Open questions

None.
````
